valuation.method: Forward Non-GAAP Diluted EPS x P/E (FY2027E EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: Steeper IRA Medicare price-setting pressure on Austedo in Jan 2027, generic Revlimid erosion, and slower margin expansion
bear.assumption: FY2027E non-GAAP diluted EPS $2.25 at 16.0x P/E

base.driver: Continued Austedo, Ajovy, and Uzedy growth, ~26%-27% non-GAAP operating margin, and deleveraging toward 2.0x net debt/EBITDA
base.assumption: FY2027E non-GAAP diluted EPS $2.55 at 19.0x P/E

bull.driver: Achieving 30% non-GAAP operating margin target in 2027, pipeline/biosimilar catalysts, and biotech-like multiple re-rating
bull.assumption: FY2027E non-GAAP diluted EPS $2.85 at 21.0x P/E

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E EPS of $2.55, the $44.50 close implies 17.5x P/E; the 6-analyst equal-weight target of $50.50 implies 19.8x P/E or $2.66 EPS at 19.0x
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $2.55 (+5.7 pp at the $44.50 close)
valuation.watch_metric: Austedo, Ajovy, and Uzedy net sales growth vs. IRA Medicare price-setting impact and non-GAAP operating margin progression toward 30%

analyst_notes: Following Teva's Q3 2026 earnings beat on November 3, 2026 ($0.86 non-GAAP EPS) and raised FY2026 guidance ($1.92-$2.11 non-GAAP EPS), Piper Sandler, H.C. Wainwright, and BofA Securities all raised their targets, leaving all six tracked analysts at Buy/Overweight with targets from $47 to $56. The $50.50 equal-weight analyst target (+13.5% upside) sits 4.6 pp above our $48.45 base case (+8.9% upside), equivalent to either ~0.8x higher P/E or ~$0.11 higher FY2027E EPS. All six targets are recent (September-November 2026) and heavily concentrated in Buy/Overweight ratings.
